inventory.name: Purpose & Strategic Direction
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 6 anchored questions based on Mission, vision and values (Collins & Porras core ideology); ISO 9001 §4.1 context of the organisation, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Strategy Alignment Matrix
inventory.computes: Links your objectives to the initiatives and spend under way, and compares each objective’s share of spend with its share of importance.
inventory.limits: It works only from the objectives, initiatives and figures you list; it does not judge whether the objectives themselves are right.

inventory.name: Strategic Priority Ranking
inventory.computes: Weighted scoring of your options against your criteria, normalised for scale, with a check on how sensitive the winner is to the weights.
inventory.limits: Criteria, weights and scores are yours; it does not research or verify the options.

inventory.name: OKR & Strategy Execution Review
inventory.computes: Progress of each key result from its start value toward its target, compared with how much of the period has passed, rolled up by objective.
inventory.limits: Values are what you enter; it does not pull figures from other systems or judge whether targets are ambitious enough.

inventory.name: External Environment Scan
inventory.computes: Ranks the external factors you list by impact × likelihood and checks every PESTLE heading and competitive force was considered.
inventory.limits: It does not research the market; factors and ratings are yours.

inventory.name: Operating Model Review
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 6 anchored questions based on McKinsey 7-S; Galbraith Star Model, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Delivery Flow Metrics
inventory.computes: Throughput, cycle time, work in progress, predictability and flow efficiency, with a Little’s Law consistency check.
inventory.limits: Reads only the period figures you enter; it is not connected to your task tools.

inventory.name: Drift & Stability Monitor
inventory.computes: Natural process limits for any metric and the standard control-chart rules that separate real drift from routine variation.
inventory.limits: Reads only the values you enter; it detects that something changed, not why.

inventory.name: Dependency Board
inventory.computes: Which dependencies between teams are late or overdue, and which providing teams are most often late.
inventory.limits: Works from the dependencies and dates you record; it does not read project tools.

inventory.name: Workload & Capacity Balance
inventory.computes: Utilisation of each team or person against an 85% safe ceiling, and where spare capacity could absorb overload.
inventory.limits: It does not know whether skills transfer between teams; check each suggested move.

inventory.name: Bottleneck & Process Improvement
inventory.computes: Finds the bottleneck step from the capacities you enter for each step, and where improvement would actually raise throughput.
inventory.limits: It works on the step figures you enter; it does not measure your process or its costs.

inventory.name: Root Cause Analysis
inventory.computes: Builds the cause chains, ranks root causes by evidence and by whether they explain the facts, and shows which fishbone categories were not considered.
inventory.limits: It organises and tests your analysis; it cannot find causes you have not listed.

inventory.name: Operating Rhythm & Meeting Design
inventory.computes: The time your recurring meetings cost per person, how much of it is status updates, and whether the weekly, monthly and quarterly review levels exist.
inventory.limits: It uses the meetings you list; it does not read calendars or judge meeting quality.

inventory.name: Productivity & Output Metrics
inventory.computes: Quality-adjusted output per 100 hours for each team, the change from last period, and the spread between the best team and the median.
inventory.limits: Output units must mean the same thing across teams; it cannot normalise for different kinds of work.

inventory.name: Collaboration Network Map
inventory.computes: Connections per person or team, collaboration load share, single points of failure and isolated groups.
inventory.limits: Built from the relationships you list; it does not read email or chat data.

inventory.name: Technology ROI & Total Cost
inventory.computes: Return on each system from total annual cost against the value of time saved, plus adoption and unused licences.
inventory.limits: Time saved is your estimate; it does not measure usage from the systems themselves.

inventory.name: Innovation Funnel
inventory.computes: Conversion between innovation stages, time to market and revenue returned per unit of innovation spend.
inventory.limits: Works from your stage counts; it does not judge the quality of individual ideas.

inventory.name: Data Quality Check
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 7 anchored questions based on DAMA-DMBOK data quality dimensions; ISO 8000, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Decision Quality
inventory.computes: Scores one decision against a fixed set of requirements (options, criteria, owner, information and more), limited by its weakest requirement.
inventory.limits: It rates how the decision is being made, not whether the eventual choice is right.

inventory.name: Decision Register
inventory.computes: Decision cycle time, stalled and recurring decisions, missing owners and rationale, overdue reviews and reversal rate.
inventory.limits: Built from the decisions you record; it does not judge whether a decision was right.

inventory.name: Decision Rights Matrix
inventory.computes: Checks each decision has exactly one accountable owner and someone responsible, and finds roles that hold too many final calls.
inventory.limits: It checks the matrix you enter, not whether people follow it in practice.

inventory.name: Option Comparison
inventory.computes: Weighted scoring of your options against your criteria, normalised for scale, with a check on how sensitive the winner is to the weights.
inventory.limits: Criteria, weights and scores are yours; it does not research or verify the options.

inventory.name: Scenarios & Expected Value
inventory.computes: Compares your options across the futures you define under three decision rules, and reports what perfect information about the future would be worth.
inventory.limits: The futures, their likelihoods and payoffs are yours; it does not forecast which future will happen.

inventory.name: Decision Timing & Cost of Delay
inventory.computes: Orders pending items by cost of delay divided by duration (WSJF), places them on the Eisenhower matrix, and flags deadlines that can no longer be met.
inventory.limits: Cost of delay is your estimate; the order is only as good as those figures.

inventory.name: Priority Conflict Check
inventory.computes: Checks the objectives you enter pair by pair and flags tensions that have no stated trade-off.
inventory.limits: It only finds conflicts among the objectives you enter; it does not know your other goals.

inventory.name: Stakeholder Map
inventory.computes: Places stakeholders on the power–interest grid, rates their salience, and computes power-weighted support.
inventory.limits: Positions are your read of each stakeholder; it does not survey them.

inventory.name: Force Field Analysis
inventory.computes: Totals driving and resisting forces and names the resisting forces to reduce first.
inventory.limits: Strengths are your judgement; it does not measure the forces.

inventory.name: Decision Method Selector
inventory.computes: Classifies the decision situation (Cynefin domain and reversibility) and recommends how much process it needs and which tools to use.
inventory.limits: The answer depends on how you describe the situation; it does not make the decision.

inventory.name: Benefits & After-Action Review
inventory.computes: Planned against realised value per item and overall, with the lessons recorded.
inventory.limits: Values are what you report; attributing results to one decision is your judgement.

inventory.name: Forecast Calibration
inventory.computes: Brier scores per person and overall, and how often things predicted at each confidence level actually happened.
inventory.limits: Only resolved predictions count; it measures past judgement, not ability on new kinds of question.

inventory.name: Early Warning Indicators
inventory.computes: Red, amber or green status for each indicator against your thresholds, its direction of travel, and how soon it reaches red at the current pace.
inventory.limits: Values are entered by you; it is not connected to live data.

inventory.name: Risk Register
inventory.computes: Inherent and estimated residual risk, a heat map, risks above appetite, overdue actions and missing owners.
inventory.limits: Scores are your judgement; residual risk is estimated from the control rating, not tested.

inventory.name: Business Continuity (BIA)
inventory.computes: Recovery priority, activities whose recovery objective or tested recovery is too slow, untested plans and single-person dependencies.
inventory.limits: Works from the times and test results you record; it does not run a recovery test.

inventory.name: Cyber Security Posture
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 9 anchored questions based on NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0; ISO/IEC 27001, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Organisational Resilience
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 7 anchored questions based on ISO 22316 organisational resilience, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Governance Assessment
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 7 anchored questions based on ISO 37000 governance of organisations; OECD Principles; King IV, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Commitments & Obligations Register
inventory.computes: Which commitments are overdue, due soon or not started, the rate at which commitments have been kept, and missing owners.
inventory.limits: Tracks the commitments you record; it does not read contracts.

inventory.name: Compliance Assessment
inventory.computes: The share of obligations that are controlled and evidenced, gaps by regulation, and reviews older than a year.
inventory.limits: It does not interpret the law; the obligations and their status are yours. Not a legal opinion.

inventory.name: Ethics & Integrity
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 6 anchored questions based on ISO 37001 anti-bribery; ISO 37002 whistleblowing, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Financial Controls Review
inventory.computes: Control effectiveness by process using COSO deficiency levels, plus untested and unowned controls.
inventory.limits: Uses the test results you record; it does not test controls or replace an audit.

inventory.name: Culture & Values Assessment
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 8 anchored questions based on Culture traits model (Denison & Mishra, 1995); team psychological safety (Edmondson, 1999) — original question wording, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Skills Gap Analysis
inventory.computes: The gap between required and current skill levels by role, coverage, and skills held by only one person.
inventory.limits: Levels are your assessment; it does not test anyone’s skills.

inventory.name: Workforce Plan
inventory.computes: Projected supply against demand for each role, the gap, how much internal moves can cover, and the hire or develop route.
inventory.limits: Demand and leaver numbers are your estimates; it does not forecast the business.

inventory.name: Succession & Bench Strength
inventory.computes: Measures succession coverage for each critical seat from the successors and readiness you enter.
inventory.limits: It works from the figures you enter; it does not assess the people themselves.

inventory.name: Human Capital Metrics
inventory.computes: The ISO 30414 core people measures you have data for: turnover, hiring, time to fill, mobility, training, absence and productivity.
inventory.limits: Uses the period totals you enter; it does not read HR or payroll systems.

inventory.name: Performance–Potential Grid
inventory.computes: Places each person on the 9-box grid, shows the distribution, and flags key talent at risk of leaving.
inventory.limits: Ratings are managers’ judgements; calibrate them before acting.

inventory.name: Engagement Survey
inventory.computes: eNPS overall and by team from staff answers, response rates, and anonymity protection for small teams.
inventory.limits: It scores survey results you collected; it does not run the survey or explain the reasons behind scores.

inventory.name: Development ROI
inventory.computes: Evaluation depth per Kirkpatrick level and Phillips ROI after adjusting the benefit for attribution and confidence.
inventory.limits: Benefit, attribution and confidence are estimates; the ROI is only as good as them.

inventory.name: Competency & 360 Review
inventory.computes: Gaps against expected levels using others’ ratings, plus blind spots and hidden strengths where self and others disagree.
inventory.limits: Ratings are opinions; use them for development conversations, not as a sole basis for pay or dismissal.

inventory.name: Next-Role Readiness
inventory.computes: How far a person meets a target role’s requirements and how long the gaps take to close.
inventory.limits: Levels and timings are your assessment.

inventory.name: Change Readiness
inventory.computes: Readiness of each affected group across the five change beliefs, weighted by group size, and the weakest belief to work on first.
inventory.limits: Scores are your assessment of each group; ideally ask the groups themselves. Uses a published research model with original wording, not a licensed survey.

inventory.name: Transformation Programme Tracker
inventory.computes: Milestone delivery and slippage, and benefits forecast against plan.
inventory.limits: Dates and values are what you record; it does not read project plans.

inventory.name: Growth Opportunity Scoring
inventory.computes: RICE score (reach × impact × confidence ÷ effort) for each opportunity and the effort mix across the three horizons.
inventory.limits: All inputs are your estimates; it does not research markets.

inventory.name: Growth Pathways
inventory.computes: Compares the growth pathways you enter and returns a sequenced portfolio that fits your capacity.
inventory.limits: Pathway values and costs are your estimates; it does not find new pathways or supply market data.

inventory.name: Growth Plan Feasibility
inventory.computes: Sequences the initiatives you enter into periods, respecting dependencies and per-period capacity, and reports the critical path.
inventory.limits: Effort, value and dependencies are your estimates; it does not estimate the work or assign people.

inventory.name: Modernisation Roadmap
inventory.computes: Sequences the initiatives you enter into periods, respecting dependencies and per-period capacity, and reports the critical path.
inventory.limits: Effort, value and dependencies are your estimates; it does not estimate the work or assign people.

inventory.name: Digital Maturity
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 6 anchored questions based on Digital maturity models (MIT CISR; TM Forum DMM), by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.

inventory.name: Financial Health Ratios
inventory.computes: Profit-and-loss arithmetic on the periods you enter: gross and operating margin, revenue growth, net burn, runway and revenue per head.
inventory.limits: It does not forecast future periods and does not value the business: every figure describes the historical periods you entered.

inventory.name: Rolling Forecast & 13-Week Cash
inventory.computes: Week-by-week cash for the next 13 weeks with the low point, and a 12-month revenue, cost and cash projection from your growth assumptions.
inventory.limits: It projects from the flows and growth rates you enter; it does not know about payments you have not listed.

inventory.name: KPI Driver Tree
inventory.computes: Splits return on equity into margin, asset turnover and leverage, and shows which driver moved it since the prior period.
inventory.limits: Uses the totals you enter; it does not read accounts or adjust for one-off items.

inventory.name: Cost & Spend Analysis
inventory.computes: Ranks cost lines into A, B and C classes by cumulative share of spend, totals by category, and flags fast-growing lines.
inventory.limits: Finds where spend is concentrated, not whether it is wasteful.

inventory.name: Business Valuation
inventory.computes: Enterprise and equity value from your cash-flow forecast, discount rate and long-term growth, with a sensitivity range.
inventory.limits: An indicative income-approach value only; it is not a formal valuation opinion and uses your forecast as given.

inventory.name: Finance Function Maturity
inventory.computes: Scores your answers to 6 anchored questions based on FP&A maturity models, by area and overall, counting unevidenced answers for less.
inventory.limits: It reflects the answers given; it is a structured self-assessment, not an audit or certification.
